rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's seventeen builder trees go (ficus, magnolias, jacarandas and a coral along the back fences, magnolias and a jacaranda 3 m from the house fronts, a few in the yards inside the wrought-iron fence); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the two swing sets, on the open lot corner, in a yard inside the iron fence, and one back yard.

trees.why: the north-west back yard with the swing set (2.8 m off): shade over the swings
the yard with the other swing set (2.8 m off): a coral tree over the swings
the open lot corner inside the wrought-iron fence, 29 m from the walls: a full magnolia
the yard inside the same fence, 13.5 m from the house
